about: The reviewed client checks by role name (ADR-0059 decision 7, story R0.13), read by roleNameLiterals.test.ts. Decisions: kept (tests the name on purpose), compat (serves the single admin_role field the Users page still reads; goes with R0.8c, issue 2586), project (a project role name, which ADR-0059 does not change), unrelated (not a role name). The four-name type AdminRole in api/adminUsersApi.ts types that same compat field and goes with it; the server never trusts any of these: it tests admin.auth.users.super_admin.

sites.why: Presentation only: the single-role picker of a super_admin row is disabled for a caller who cannot assign super_admin. Reads the compat admin_role field; R0.8c replaces the picker with the role set.

Presentation only: the super_admin option of the single-role picker is disabled without admin.auth.users.super_admin (canAssignSuperAdmin is the permission). The server refuses on the permission either way.
The default project role offered when adding a project member: the project role admin, not an administration role.
The revocation reason of a device session (revoke_reason admin), not a role.
